material: Bambu PAHT-CF remains the prototype material. Isotropic PLA is only a numerical comparison proxy.

orientations.receiver_core: Broad central underside Z0 on the bed. Inspect short perimeter overhangs, guide bridges and accessible nut-pocket supports.
orientations.case_shell: Bottom edge on the bed. Use a brim as needed; inspect the retention ledge and nut loading windows.
orientations.case_lid: Outside upper face on the bed; the supplied print STL is already flipped. The yoke pocket opens upward while printing and leaves a1 mm floor; inspect its thickness and flatness.
orientations.keeper: Broad Y side on the bed; the supplied print STL rotates90° about X. Preserve the3 mm bar and3.3 mm fork columns.
orientations.payload_adapter: Broad payload mounting face Z−5.3 on the bed; inspect the4.2 mm lug-window bridge.
orientations.servo_clamp: Flat broad face on the bed; inspect the countersinks and their edge ligaments.

critical_receiving_measurements: MG90D case, shaft offset and spline height, supplied screw, wire exit and usable horn hole location.
Smooth sleeve nominal OD4 mm, ID2.1 mm and length6 mm; inspect bore, ovality and running finish.
M2 flat-head screws: verify head diameter≤4 mm and head height≤1 mm against the actual supplier drawing.
M3 nuts: AF5.5 ×2.4 mm; M2 plain nuts: AF4 ×1.6 mm; M2 follower locknut: AF4 ×2.8 mm.
Flat servo lead must fit the4.0 ×1.6 mm routing reservation with the modeled3 mm centerline bends.
acceptance: Each printed part is one connected solid; integral features never separate in the exploded view.
Finish the guide and keeper until they slide freely over the entire stroke; preserve the reviewed load-bearing walls.
Rigid retained parts fit the85.6 ×54 ×20 mm box. The flexible lead exits through the top; the adapter departs below.
Measure at least0.5 mm fully open lug clearance at the calibrated endpoint, including available lateral play.
Check each printed unit. Nominal CAD clearance does not establish the fit of a material or printer process.
Confirm clearance to the inner lid through loaded withdrawal. The prescribed1.6568° rocking check consumes0.01 mm of the0.4 mm nominal slot backlash; it is not a coupled contact solution.
